notes.note: Hunk ids are stable only across reads of an unchanged tree: staging one hunk changes the index header and offsets of the file's other hunks, so a fresh collect() re-keys them. The extension must keep the Hunk objects from the planning read and act on their stored patches (git apply tolerates line offsets), using checkApplies for drift; it must not recollect and match by id after each action. collect() leaves PlanningInput.context unset; quoted paths with tabs/newlines are unsupported.

notes.reason: ReviewController keeps the planning-read Hunk objects and acts on their stored patches with checkApplies before each action; covered by the stage/unstage/discard/stale integration tests.
